package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type onboardingTurnApplyStub struct {
	command domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand
	result  domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult
	err     error
}

func (stub *onboardingTurnApplyStub) Handle(_ context.Context, command domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	stub.command = command
	return stub.result, stub.err
}

type onboardingTurnGetStub struct {
	studentID, commandID string
	result               domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult
	err                  error
}

func (stub *onboardingTurnGetStub) Handle(_ context.Context, studentID, commandID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.commandID = studentID, commandID
	return stub.result, stub.err
}

type onboardingTurnProofStub struct {
	proof  domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof
	result domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult
	err    error
}

func (stub *onboardingTurnProofStub) Handle(_ context.Context, proof domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	stub.proof = proof
	return stub.result, stub.err
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingTurnTransportIsPrivateStrictAndRouteBound(t *testing.T) {
	command := testTeacherOnboardingTurnCommand()
	result := domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema, StudentCommandID: command.StudentCommandID, CanonicalStudentMessageID: command.CanonicalStudentMessageID, StudentEffectState: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnEffectAccepted}
	apply := &onboardingTurnApplyStub{result: result}
	get := &onboardingTurnGetStub{result: result}
	proof := &onboardingTurnProofStub{result: result}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{OnboardingTurnApply: apply, OnboardingTurns: get, OnboardingTurnProofs: proof}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token")
	path := "/v1/teacher/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/onboarding/turns"
	body, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	response := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, path, body, command.StudentCommandID, "teacher-token")
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || apply.command.StudentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("apply status=%d command=%+v body=%s", response.Code, apply.command, response.Body.String())
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"slots", "code_value", "ai_execution", "profile", "body"} {
		if bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("result leaked %q: %s", forbidden, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	unknown := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, path, append(body[:len(body)-1], []byte(`,"unexpected":true}`)...), command.StudentCommandID, "teacher-token")
	if unknown.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("unknown property status=%d body=%s", unknown.Code, unknown.Body.String())
	}
	wrongHeader := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, path, body, "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222223", "teacher-token")
	if wrongHeader.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("mismatched header status=%d", wrongHeader.Code)
	}
	missingToken := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, path, body, command.StudentCommandID, "")
	if missingToken.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("missing token status=%d", missingToken.Code)
	}

	getResponse := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodGet, path+"/"+command.StudentCommandID, nil, "", "teacher-token")
	if getResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || get.studentID != apply.command.StudentID || get.commandID != command.StudentCommandID {
		t.Fatalf("GET status=%d ids=%s/%s", getResponse.Code, get.studentID, get.commandID)
	}
	proofBody, err := json.Marshal(domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProofSchema, Command: command})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	proofResponse := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, path+"/"+command.StudentCommandID+"/prove-no-effect", proofBody, command.StudentCommandID, "teacher-token")
	if proofResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || proof.proof.Command.StudentID != apply.command.StudentID {
		t.Fatalf("proof status=%d proof=%+v", proofResponse.Code, proof.proof)
	}
}

func TestTeacherOnboardingTurnCapabilityDisabledIsDistinctFromConflict(t *testing.T) {
	command := testTeacherOnboardingTurnCommand()
	body, err := json.Marshal(command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	apply := &onboardingTurnApplyStub{err: domain.ErrForbidden}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{OnboardingTurnApply: apply, OnboardingTurns: &onboardingTurnGetStub{}, OnboardingTurnProofs: &onboardingTurnProofStub{}}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token")
	response := performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router, http.MethodPost, "/v1/teacher/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/onboarding/turns", body, command.StudentCommandID, "teacher-token")
	if response.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("capability disabled")) {
		t.Fatalf("disabled capability status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func performOnboardingTurnHTTP(router http.Handler, method, path string, body []byte, idempotencyKey, token string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	if idempotencyKey != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}

func testTeacherOnboardingTurnCommand() domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand {
	confidence := 5000
	direction := "backend"
	return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentCommandID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PersonalTeacherID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", SourceEventID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", DialogCausationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		TeacherJobID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", AIExecutionID: testOnboardingTurnStringPointer("88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"), CorrelationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", CausationID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		ExpectedDraftVersion: 0, Slots: []domain.StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{{SlotCode: domain.StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode, CodeValue: &direction, Origin: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}},
	}
}

func testOnboardingTurnStringPointer(value string) *string { return &value }
